mapper.update: update t800_uv_inexus_concise.f_t_measure_task set is_delete='1' where id=#{taskId}
mapper.select: select id as taskId, task_name as taskName from t800_uv_inexus_concise.f_t_measure_task where project_item_key = #{projectId} and measure_type = #{measureType}

select name as name, identity as identity, print_title as printTitle, locate as locate from t800_uv_inexus_concise.f_t_measure_preset_head where measure_type = #{measure_type}
and sample_kind = #{sample_kind}

select t1.id, t2.method_name as methodName, t1.user_id as userId, t1.task_name as taskName, t1.create_time as createTime, t1.method_key as methodKey, t1.sample_key as sampleKey, t1.measure_type as measureType, t1.project_item_key as projectItemKey, t1.zero_param as zeroParam, t1.fitting_param as fittingParam, t1.end_save_time as endSaveTime, t1.device_serial_number as deviceSerialNumber, t1.image_data as imageData from t800_uv_inexus_concise.f_t_measure_task t1 left join t800_uv_inexus_concise.f_t_measure_method t2 on t1.method_key = t2.id where t1.is_delete = '0' and t1.user_id = #{dto.updateBy} and t1.measure_type = #{dto.methodType}
and t1.task_name like concat('%',#{dto.taskName},'%')
and t2.method_name like concat('%',#{dto.methodName},'%')
order by t1.end_save_time desc
